zh.summary: 有能力進入系統，不代表有權測試；先確認誰批准、範圍、方法與停止條件。

sourceBody.text: Module 01：Introduction to Ethical Hacking｜新路線第 3 單元
建議閱讀：8～10 分鐘。
先記住：有能力進入系統，不代表有權測試；取得測試授權，也不代表什麼都能做。
M01-01 問「保護哪些安全目標」，M01-02 問「什麼值得優先保護」。今天接著問：為了驗證安全問題，我們究竟被允許做哪些事？
一、白話定義：不是看動機，而是看授權與行為
想像你請鎖匠檢查家門。你同意他檢查門鎖，不代表同意他翻抽屜、拆鄰居的門，或把你家的鑰匙照片公開。
Ethical Hacking（道德駭客／倫理駭客）：為改善安全，在合法授權及約定界線內，檢查系統可能被如何濫用，並負責任地處理發現與資料。
善意很重要，但「我是想幫忙」「沒有破壞東西」「最後會通報」都不能取代授權。系統能連上、帳號能登入、工具能執行，也只是技術能力，不是測試許可。
二、三個詞一起懂：授權、範圍、ROE

rows: Authorization（授權）
誰有權批准，批准誰做什麼？
有權負責測試環境的人，明確批准指定團隊進行測試。
Scope（範圍）
哪些目標、帳號、功能在內？哪些排除？
只測教學測試站；正式站、員工信箱及支付商均排除。
Rules of Engagement，ROE（交戰規則／測試行動規則）
在什麼條件下、用什麼方式測？何時停？
約定時段、可用方法、禁止操作、停止與通報程序。

sourceBody.text: 可以把它記成：授權回答「可不可以」，範圍回答「到哪裡」，ROE 回答「怎麼做、何時停」。
三者不是一定要分成三份文件；有些組織把它們寫在同一份評估計畫或 ROE。重點是內容清楚、可查核，由有權的人核准，而不是文件名稱漂亮。[NIST SP 800-115，第 6 章與附錄 B](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/SP/nistspecialpublication800-115.pdf)
三、動手前，要確認哪些條件？
以下是本課的實務整理，不是所有組織通用的法律合約模板：

items: 1. 核准者與執行者：批准的人是否真的對目標有授權權限？誰可以執行、誰負責聯絡？
2. 目標清單與排除項：清楚列出環境、網域／位址、帳號與功能。不能只寫「公司的東西」。
3. 時間與時區：何時開始、何時結束？逾時不因測試尚未完成就自行延長。
4. 允許與禁止的方法：例如只檢查測試帳號權限，不做密碼猜測、服務阻斷、社交工程或破壞性操作，除非另外明確獲准。
5. 資料界線：使用合成資料；證據收多少、放哪裡、誰能看、何時刪除，都要先談清楚。
6. 停止與復測條件：例如影響服務、碰到真實個資、目標不符清單就先停止相關測試；誰確認安全後可以批准恢復？
7. 報告與收尾：向誰通報、如何交付結果、移除哪些測試資料或帳號；不要自行刪除原始事件紀錄。

sourceBody.text: 授權應留下可核對的書面紀錄。遇到委外、雲端或第三方服務，還要確認相應權限與服務條款，不能把「客戶同意」當成對所有供應商系統的通行證。實際法律責任仍需依適用法規與合約確認，本課不是法律意見。
四、完整例子：Northstar 的權限檢查
以下是合成紙上情境，不會連線到真實系統。
Northstar 想確認「學生 A 不應讀到學生 B 的私人作答」。有權管理測試環境的負責人核准這份約定：

rows: 目標
隔離測試環境 training.example.test
時段
約定測試日 14:00～15:00，Asia/Taipei
身分／資料
指定測試帳號 A、B，以及虛構作答
允許
在約定功能內，核對 A、B 的讀取權限，保存最小必要證據
排除
正式站、第三方登入服務、其他帳號；不猜密碼、不做壓力測試
停止
出現真實資料、服務異常或越出清單；通知指定負責人，依批准再恢復

sourceBody.text: 14:20，A 能讀到 B 的一筆虛構作答。合理做法不是「既然成功，就把所有人的資料都下載下來」，而是記下測試身分、時間、步驟、預期與實際結果，保留足以重現問題的最少證據，再依約定通報。
接著頁面連到另一個未列入範圍的主機，怎麼辦？連結不是授權；先停止對新主機的測試，請負責人釐清或補充核准。
如果這時已經 15:00，即使只差一步也不能自行續測。要先停下來，再確認是否取得延長授權。
五、三個常見誤判

rows: 「我是公司員工，本來就有帳號。」
工作上的使用權，不自動等於掃描、滲透或讀取其他人的資料的測試權。
「客戶說可以測 A，A 又能連到 B。」
授權不會沿著網路連線自動擴張；B 要另外核對。
「AI 推薦這個指令，工具也是知名工具。」
AI 和工具不會替你判斷所有權、授權、資料保護與安全限制；人仍需核對目標、參數和後果。

sourceBody.text: 補充：簽署 NDA（保密協議）主要處理資訊保密義務，不能只憑 NDA 就推論自己獲准進行任何測試。同樣地，看到網站有弱點回報信箱，也不表示所有測試方式都在允許範圍。
六、防護與證據：別讓檢測變成另一個風險
對委託方，保護措施包括隔離環境、合成資料、受限測試帳號、明確聯絡窗口，以及事前定義停止與復原流程。對測試方，則要持續核對範圍，最少化取得的資料，保護報告，不擅自公開敏感發現。
證據至少要區分：

items: 授權證據：誰批准、哪個版本、有效期間與允許項目。
技術觀察：在哪個環境、用什麼身分，實際看到了什麼。
推論限制：測試環境中的結果，不自動證明正式環境也有相同問題；一次成功也不代表所有帳號都受影響。

sourceBody.text: NIST 的評估指南將規劃、執行協調、資料處理及測後報告分開處理，提醒檢測不只有「找到漏洞」這一步。[NIST SP 800-115](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/115/final)

visual.caption: 測試前與測試中的授權檢查
visual.description: 補充圖解｜每次準備採取新動作，都要核對約定；不確定時先停下來釐清。

items.title: 確認核准
items.body: 有權的人批准指定測試者、環境與目標。

items.title: 核對行動
items.body: 目標、方法、資料與時段都符合約定，才進行該動作。

items.title: 遇到界線
items.body: 目標未列入、發生異常或時段結束：停止相關測試並通報。

items.title: 恢復與收尾
items.body: 依核准條件恢復；最小化證據、交付報告並完成約定清理。

sourceBody.text: 七、一個小檢核
你獲准今天 14:00～15:00，使用測試帳號檢查 A 測試站。14:50 發現 A 會連到未列入清單的 B 主機。你認為 B 很可能也有弱點，是否可以順便測？請用一句話說明你會怎麼做，以及為什麼。
記憶口訣：先確認誰准、准哪裡、准怎麼做；遇到越界或停止條件，先停再確認。
參考解答供自己核對，展開不代表已經回答或理解，也不會將作答傳給助教或寫入個人學習紀錄。

sourceBody.summary: 展開參考解答｜連得上不代表獲准測試
paragraphs: 不能順便測 B。B 沒有列在本次範圍內，即使從 A 可以連過去，也不代表測試授權會跟著延伸。
先停止對 B 的操作，把發現的連結及範圍疑問通知指定負責人；若要測 B，需先確認有權核准的人已明確補充目標、方法與時段。
A 的其他工作也只能在原授權內進行；到 15:00 要停，不因等待回覆而自動延長。

en.summary: Technical capability is not permission. Confirm the approver, scope, allowed methods and stopping conditions before testing.

sourceBody.text: Module 01: Introduction to Ethical Hacking | Reading-route unit 3
Suggested reading time: 8–10 minutes.
Remember: being able to enter a system does not authorize testing it; permission to test does not authorize every action.
M01-01 asks which security objectives to protect. M01-02 asks what deserves priority. This unit asks which actions we are permitted to take when checking a security problem.
1. Plain-language definition: authorization and conduct, not just intent
Imagine hiring a locksmith to inspect your front door. Permission to inspect its lock does not permit searching your drawers, dismantling a neighbor's door or publishing photographs of your keys.
Ethical hacking means examining how systems could be misused to improve security, within lawful authorization and agreed boundaries, while responsibly handling findings and data.

Good intent matters, but “I wanted to help,” “I caused no damage” and “I will report it later” do not replace authorization. Connectivity, a working login and an executable tool are technical capabilities, not testing permission.
2. Three connected terms: authorization, scope and ROE

rows: Authorization
Who has authority to approve whom to do what?
A person authorized to govern the test environment explicitly approves a designated testing team.
Scope
Which targets, accounts and functions are included or excluded?
Only the training test site; production, employee mail and the payment provider are excluded.
Rules of Engagement (ROE)
Under what conditions and methods may testing occur, and when must it stop?
Agreed time window, permitted methods, prohibited operations, stopping and reporting procedures.

sourceBody.text: Authorization asks “may we?” Scope asks “where are the boundaries?” ROE asks “how do we operate, and when do we stop?”

These need not be three separate documents. Some organizations combine them in an assessment plan or ROE. Clear, verifiable content approved by someone with appropriate authority matters more than the document title. [NIST SP 800-115, Chapter 6 and Appendix B](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/SP/nistspecialpublication800-115.pdf)
3. What must be checked before starting?
This is the lesson's practical synthesis, not a universal legal contract template:

items: 1. Approvers and testers: does the approver actually have authority over the target? Who may perform the work, and who is the contact?
2. Allowlist and exclusions: identify environments, domains/addresses, accounts and functions. “Company systems” is not sufficiently precise.
3. Time and timezone: when does testing start and end? Unfinished work does not automatically extend the window.

4. Permitted and prohibited techniques: for example, check test-account permissions without password guessing, denial of service, social engineering or destructive operations unless separately and explicitly authorized.
5. Data boundaries: use synthetic data; agree on minimum evidence, storage, access and deletion.
6. Stopping and resumption: service impact, real personal data or an unlisted target can trigger stopping affected testing. Who may approve resumption after safety is confirmed?
7. Reporting and cleanup: define recipients, delivery and removal of test artifacts/accounts. Do not independently delete original incident records.

sourceBody.text: Keep verifiable written authorization. Outsourced, cloud and third-party services require checking corresponding authority and service terms: customer approval is not a pass to every supplier's system. Actual legal obligations depend on applicable laws and contracts; this lesson is not legal advice.
4. Complete example: Northstar permission assessment
This is a synthetic tabletop scenario. No real system is contacted.
Northstar wants to verify that student A cannot read student B's private answers. A responsible person with authority over the test environment approves:

rows: Target
Isolated test environment training.example.test
Window
Agreed test date, 14:00–15:00, Asia/Taipei
Identities/data
Designated test accounts A and B, with fictional answers
Permitted
Check their read permissions in agreed functions; retain minimum necessary evidence
Excluded
Production, third-party login service and other accounts; no password guessing or load testing
Stop
Real data, service disruption or an out-of-scope target; notify the contact and resume only as approved

sourceBody.text: At 14:20, A can read one fictional answer belonging to B. The appropriate response is not to download everyone's data. Record the identity, time, steps, expected and observed results, preserve the minimum evidence needed to reproduce the issue and report as agreed.
The page then links to another host absent from the scope. A link is not authorization: stop testing that new host and ask the responsible person to clarify or extend approval.
At 15:00, even one remaining step does not justify continuing. Stop and check whether an extension has been authorized.
5. Three common mistakes

rows: “I work here and already have an account.”
Permission for normal work does not automatically authorize scanning, penetration testing or reading other people's data.
“The client authorized A, and A connects to B.”
Authorization does not automatically propagate along network connections; check B separately.
“AI recommended this command, and the tool is well known.”
AI and tools do not resolve ownership, authorization, privacy and safety limits for you. People must check targets, parameters and consequences.

sourceBody.text: An NDA primarily establishes confidentiality obligations. An NDA alone does not establish permission for arbitrary testing. Likewise, a vulnerability-reporting email address does not authorize every test method.
6. Controls and evidence: do not make assessment another risk

The commissioning organization can use isolation, synthetic data, restricted test accounts, clear contacts and predefined stop/recovery procedures. Testers should continually check scope, minimize collected data, protect reports and avoid independently disclosing sensitive findings.
Separate at least:

items: Authorization evidence: approver, document version, validity period and permitted activities.
Technical observations: environment, identity and what actually happened.
Inference limits: a test-environment finding does not automatically establish the same production weakness; one successful case does not establish that all accounts are affected.

sourceBody.text: NIST's assessment guide distinguishes planning, execution coordination, data handling and post-test reporting. Finding a vulnerability is only one part of an assessment. [NIST SP 800-115](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/115/final)

visual.caption: Authorization checks before and during testing
visual.description: Supplement: check the agreement before each new action; stop and clarify uncertainty.

items.title: Confirm approval
items.body: An appropriate authority approves the testers, environment and targets.

items.title: Check the action
items.body: Proceed only when target, method, data and time fit the agreement.

items.title: At a boundary
items.body: Unlisted targets, incidents or an expired window: stop affected testing and report.

items.title: Resume and close
items.body: Resume as authorized; minimize evidence, report findings and complete agreed cleanup.

sourceBody.text: 7. One quick check

You are authorized to assess test site A today from 14:00 to 15:00 using test accounts. At 14:50, A links to host B, which is not on the allowlist. You suspect B is vulnerable too. May you test it while you are there? Explain in one sentence what you would do and why.
Memory aid: who approved, which targets, which actions? At a boundary or stopping condition, stop first and clarify.
The reference answer is for self-checking. Revealing it is not a submitted response or proof of understanding, and does not transmit an answer or update personal learning records.

sourceBody.summary: Reveal reference answer: reachable does not mean authorized
paragraphs: No. Host B is outside the approved scope. Being reachable from A does not extend authorization.
Stop actions against B and report the discovered link and scope question to the designated contact. Testing B requires explicit approval of its target, methods and window by an appropriate authority.
Any remaining work on A must stay within the original authorization. Stop at 15:00; waiting for a reply does not automatically extend the window.
